source_cache_provenance.historical_base_scope: E17 SDSD-only run identity checked; historical training split SHA not inferred
source_cache_provenance.gt_firewall: GT stored only as source loss labels; restoration and RAFT receive low/prediction only

projection.prior_centering: subtract full-clip mean over all tubelet-spatial tokens BEFORE projection
projection.pixel_descriptor: low RGB then base RGB; each patch adaptive-average-pooled to 4x4; channel,y,x
projection.pixel_centering: subtract full-clip mean over all frame-spatial patches BEFORE projection
projection.temporal_expansion: repeat_interleave each tubelet descriptor to its consecutive frames
projection.crop_policy: prepare full clip once; crop row-major patch grids; NEVER recenter cropped descriptors
projection.value_layout: [B,T,P,3*patch*patch]; spatial patches row-major; channels then patch y,x
projection.lowpass: spatial box9, reflect padding; no time filtering
projection.alignment: none; patch-relative positions retained; no subpixel-motion compensation

tokens_manifest.tensor_layout: B,N,D; N is tubelet,row,column with grid8x16x16
tokens_manifest.encoder_input: cached original LQ only, fixed crop/flip/temporal plan

address_context: Whole cached256 clip;128 crops slice matching16x16 patches without rerunning encoder
